description:
Create three product tags in WooCommerce and assign them to specific existing products.

1. Create the following product tags (via Products > Tags, or by editing products directly):
   - Tag name: Premium (slug: premium)
   - Tag name: Eco-Friendly (slug: eco-friendly)
   - Tag name: Gift Idea (slug: gift-idea)

2. Assign tags to products as follows:
   - 'Organic Cotton T-Shirt' → assign tags: Premium, Eco-Friendly
   - 'Wireless Bluetooth Headphones' → assign tags: Premium, Gift Idea
   - 'Merino Wool Sweater' → assign tags: Eco-Friendly, Gift Idea

3. Save all changes so that the tags and their product assignments are persisted.

Use the WooCommerce admin panel at http://localhost/wp-admin/ (credentials: admin / Admin1234!).
